title: Japan Shinkansen map as gitGraph (fun)
caption: Fun conceptual map, not to scale and not every station. Re-rooted south-to-north from Kagoshima-Chuo through Tokyo, with northern and regional lines branching at their real junctions. Stations are commit bubbles; the two Joetsu window-view entries are intentionally non-station video bubbles. NEXT + REVERSE means not yet open.

branches.label: main — Kyushu / Sanyo / Tokaido south-to-north trunk
branches.summary: Kagoshima-Chuo north through Hakata and Shin-Osaka to Tokyo; the geographic trunk is re-rooted south-to-north so Tokyo sits near the visual center before northern branches continue.

nodes.title: Kagoshima-Chuo
nodes.detail: Kyushu Shinkansen southern terminus and the start of this south-to-north conceptual trunk.

nodes.title: Hakata
nodes.detail: Boundary where Kyushu services meet the Sanyo Shinkansen in Fukuoka.

nodes.title: Shin-Osaka
nodes.detail: Boundary where the Sanyo Shinkansen meets the Tokaido Shinkansen.

nodes.title: Nagoya
nodes.detail: Tokaido hub; the future Chuo maglev will also serve Nagoya.

nodes.title: Tokyo
nodes.detail: Capital hub where the northern Tohoku branch and future Chuo maglev branch diverge.

branches.label: chuo-maglev — Chuo Shinkansen (L0 maglev, future)
branches.summary: Future maglev from Shinagawa in Tokyo to Nagoya; both displayed milestones are not yet open.

nodes.title: NEXT Shinagawa (Chuo maglev)
nodes.detail: Planned Tokyo maglev terminus at Shinagawa; not yet open.

nodes.title: NEXT Nagoya (Chuo maglev)
nodes.detail: Planned first-phase maglev terminus at Nagoya; not yet open.

branches.label: tohoku — Tohoku Shinkansen (E5 and related series)
branches.summary: North from Tokyo via Omiya, Fukushima, Sendai and Morioka to Shin-Aomori; Joetsu, Hokuriku, Yamagata and Akita diverge at their junctions.

nodes.title: Omiya
nodes.detail: Junction area for Joetsu and Hokuriku services via Takasaki.

nodes.title: Fukushima
nodes.detail: Yamagata mini-Shinkansen trains split from Tohoku services here.

nodes.title: Morioka
nodes.detail: Akita mini-Shinkansen trains split from Tohoku services here.

nodes.title: Shin-Aomori
nodes.detail: Northern Honshu terminus; Hokkaido Shinkansen continues through the Seikan Tunnel.

branches.label: joetsu — Joetsu Shinkansen (E7)
branches.summary: From the Omiya/Takasaki area across the mountains to Niigata on the Sea of Japan coast.

nodes.title: Niigata
nodes.detail: Joetsu Shinkansen terminus; Shinjō is instead the Yamagata Shinkansen terminus.

branches.label: window-views — Joetsu / Max Toki videos
branches.summary: Two non-station video bubbles attached at Niigata: one E7 Toki placeholder and one confirmed historic E4 Max Toki upper-deck view.

nodes.title: VIDEO E7 Toki window view
nodes.detail: Modern E7 Toki window-view slot; exact YouTube URL intentionally pending selection.

nodes.title: VIDEO E4 Max Toki upper deck
nodes.detail: Historic E4-series Max Toki second-floor window view, Tokyo to Niigata, 4K60fps: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_yvTkWhkLC8

branches.label: hokuriku — Hokuriku Shinkansen (E7 / W7)
branches.summary: From the Omiya/Takasaki area via Nagano and Kanazawa to Tsuruga.

nodes.title: Tsuruga
nodes.detail: Current Hokuriku Shinkansen terminus after the 2024 extension.

branches.label: yamagata — Yamagata Shinkansen (E8)
branches.summary: Mini-Shinkansen toward Shinjo; trains split from the Tohoku service at Fukushima and continue over converted conventional track.

nodes.title: Yamagata
nodes.detail: Prefectural capital and principal intermediate hub.

nodes.title: Shinjo
nodes.detail: Northern terminus of the Yamagata Shinkansen.

branches.label: akita — Akita Shinkansen (E6)
branches.summary: Mini-Shinkansen toward Akita; trains split from the Tohoku service at Morioka and continue over converted conventional track.

nodes.title: Akita
nodes.detail: Terminus of the Akita Shinkansen.

branches.label: hokkaido — Hokkaido Shinkansen (H5 / E5)
branches.summary: Through the Seikan Tunnel to Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto; the Sapporo extension remains under construction.

nodes.title: Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto
nodes.detail: Current northern terminus and gateway to Hakodate.

nodes.title: NEXT Sapporo
nodes.detail: Sapporo extension under construction and not yet open; marked NEXT / REVERSE.
